title: Fixed Open Half Shell and Twin Pull Cord Sock Aid
description: One newly authored complete static sock-donning-aid exterior. A full finite-thickness half-cylinder shell is open along its top and at both longitudinal ends, with continuous inner and outer faces and blunt rim/end walls. Two whole pierced circular ears join its upper sides. Each whole cord passes through a real ear opening, terminates at a complete inner stopper and runs outward and forward to a whole flat open pull ring. The two complete cords and handles are integral parts of this one dressing-aid prop, not new standalone models or a scene. All numeric geometry new; no shoehorn channel cropped, basin wall extracted, existing hand grip rescaled or old loop copied. Four opaque PBR roles, metre units Z up and whole horizontal-bounds-centred lower display datum. One original model zero scenes. Empty fixed art only, not a manufactured or validated medical/accessibility product; no sock, foot, human fit, flexibility, skin contact, dressing outcome, rehabilitation, cord tension, pull strength, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
